'''Talena Ancia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Wielding two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in combat, she was one of the commanders of the Republic forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].

==Behind the scenes==
Master Talena Ancia was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'', which added Conquest Commanders to most of the dual-faction worlds. Ancia is a rare NPC enemy, and her place at [[Kri-Ta Outpost]] on Voss is frequently occupied by a generic Veteran Jedi Battlemaster. However, her character model is glitched; she is incorrectly generated as wearing the male version of the outfit used by female Jedi Conquest Commanders. As a result, the outfit is far too large, and only the top of her head&mdash;for which hair is not generated, as the outfit is hooded&mdash;can be seen.
